recipe.title: Poulet aux arachides et légumes
recipe.description: Un classique revisité, ce ragoût onctueux et parfumé met à profit le poulet et les légumes du garde-manger pour un dîner réconfortant.
instructions: Faites chauffer 2 c. à soupe d'huile dans une marmite à feu moyen. Faites dorer les 4 cuisse de poulet sur toutes leurs faces pendant 8 minutes.
Émincez les 2 oignon, coupez les 2 tomate en dés et les 3 carotte en rondelles.
Retirez le poulet. Dans la même marmite, faites revenir les 2 oignon jusqu'à ce qu'ils soient translucides, environ 5 minutes.
Ajoutez les 2 tomate et la 1 c. à soupe de concentré de tomate. Laissez mijoter 5 minutes à feu doux.
Incorporez les 150 g de pâte d'arachide et 500 ml d'eau chaude. Mélangez bien pour obtenir une sauce homogène.

Remettez le poulet dans la marmite, ajoutez les 3 carotte. Couvrez et laissez mijoter à feu doux pendant 25 minutes, jusqu'à ce que la chair du poulet soit tendre et se détache de l'os, atteignant 74 °C à cœur.
Servez chaud.
tips: Vous pouvez ajouter un peu plus d'eau si la sauce épaissit trop.
Pour une version plus légère, retirez la peau des cuisses de poulet avant la cuisson.

recipe.title: Riz sauté aux légumes et ail
recipe.description: Un plat simple et rapide, idéal pour utiliser le riz restant et les derniers légumes frais, parfumé avec l'aromate de base indispensable.
instructions: Faites cuire les 300 g de riz dans une grande casserole d'eau bouillante pendant 12 minutes. Égouttez-le et étalez-le sur une plaque pour le laisser refroidir rapidement avant de le passer au réfrigérateur si besoin.
Émincez le 1 oignon et les 2 gousse d'ail. Coupez les 2 tomate en dés.
Dans une poêle, faites chauffer 1 c. à soupe d'huile à feu vif.
Ajoutez le 1 oignon émincé et faites-le sauter 3 minutes jusqu'à ce qu'il soit doré.
Ajoutez les 2 gousse d'ail et faites revenir 1 minute jusqu'à ce qu'elles soient parfumées.
Incorporez les 2 tomate et faites cuire 3 minutes jusqu'à ce qu'elles ramollissent.
Ajoutez le riz cuit et faites sauter le tout pendant 5 minutes en remuant, jusqu'à ce que le riz soit bien chaud et légèrement croustillant par endroits.
Servez immédiatement.
tips: Utilisez du riz froid de la veille pour un meilleur résultat lors du sautage.
Vous pouvez ajouter un œuf battu à la fin de la cuisson pour enrichir le plat.
recipe.suggestion: Idéal aussi pour un déjeuner rapide au bureau.

recipe.description: Un plat mijoté végétarien, parfumé aux épices douces, où la carotte devient la star. Accompagné de semoule, c'est un déjeuner complet et réconfortant.

recipe.description: Un plat complet aux saveurs du Maghreb, alliant la douceur des carottes fondantes à la texture des pois chiches, parfait pour un déjeuner équilibré.

recipes.title: Ginger Chicken and Broccoli Stir-fry

recipe.title: Ginger Chicken and Broccoli Stir-fry
recipe.description: A light and fragrant weeknight stir-fry featuring tender chicken thighs and crisp-tender broccoli, infused with the warmth of fresh ginger and savory soy sauce.
instructions: Rinse 150 g of rice under cold water. Place in a pot with 300 ml of water, bring to a boil, cover, and reduce heat to low. Simmer for 12 minutes until water is absorbed and rice is fluffy.
Cut 250 g of chicken thigh into bite-sized pieces. Cut 1/2 piece of broccoli into small florets. Finely mince 1 piece of ginger and 2 cloves of garlic.

Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a wok or pan over medium-high heat. Add the 250 g of chicken thigh and stir-fry for 6-8 minutes until the chicken reaches 74 °C at the core, juices run clear, and no trace of pink remains.
Add the 1/2 piece of broccoli florets and a splash of water, cover for 2 minutes until broccoli is vibrant green and tender-crisp.
Add the minced 1 piece of ginger and 2 cloves of garlic, cooking for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the 2 tbsp of soy sauce, tossing everything for 1 minute to coat evenly.
Serve immediately over the cooked rice.
tips: To make it even lighter, steam the broccoli separately before adding it to the wok.
Use the remaining ginger skin to infuse hot water for a soothing after-dinner tea.
recipe.image_prompt: Professional food photography, stir-fry chicken and broccoli with glossy soy glaze, steaming white rice on the side, dark wooden table, natural top-down lighting.

recipes.title: Steamed Chicken and Egg Rice Bowl

recipe.title: Steamed Chicken and Egg Rice Bowl
recipe.description: A comforting, gentle dinner dish where chicken and egg are steamed together in a savory soy broth, perfect for a soothing evening meal.
instructions: Cook 150 g of rice as per instructions (boil in 300 ml water, simmer covered for 12 minutes).
Thinly slice 250 g of chicken thigh and mix with 1 tbsp of soy sauce.
Place the chicken in a heatproof bowl. Crack 2 eggs on top.

Set up a steamer or a pot with a rack and a little water. Place the bowl inside, cover, and steam over medium heat for 12-15 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked (internal temperature 74 °C, juices run clear) and the egg whites are set.
Chop 2 pieces of spring onions.
Remove the bowl carefully and sprinkle with the chopped spring onions.
Serve the chicken and egg mixture directly over the fluffy rice.
tips: You can add a drizzle of sesame oil at the end if you have it.
Ensure the chicken is sliced thinly to ensure it cooks through at the same time as the egg.

recipes.title: Broccoli and Egg Fried Rice

recipe.title: Broccoli and Egg Fried Rice
recipe.description: A classic, quick, and satisfying fried rice that transforms simple pantry staples into a nourishing dinner. Light, fresh, and aromatic.
instructions: Cook 200 g of rice in 400 ml water. Once cooked, spread it out on a tray to cool completely before using (this prevents mushy rice).
Finely chop 1/2 piece of broccoli, 2 cloves of garlic, and 2 pieces of spring onions.
Beat 2 eggs in a small bowl.
Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the 2 cloves of garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the 1/2 piece of chopped broccoli and sauté for 3 minutes until tender.
Push vegetables to the side, pour in the 2 eggs, and scramble until soft-set.
Add the 200 g of cooked rice to the pan. Turn heat to high and stir-fry everything for 3 minutes.
Stir in 1 tbsp of soy sauce and the chopped spring onions. Toss for 1 minute until well combined and hot.
tips: Using cold, day-old rice yields the best texture for fried rice.
If the broccoli is tough, blanch it briefly in boiling water before chopping.
recipe.suggestion: Ideal also for a quick lunch.

recipes.title: Huevos rancheros con aguacate

recipe.title: Huevos rancheros con aguacate
recipe.description: Un desayuno clásico servido como almuerzo completo. Tortillas de maíz ligeramente doradas cubiertas con una salsa de tomate casera y aguacate cremoso, coronadas con huevos estrellados.
instructions: Pica finamente la 1/2 cebolla morada y los 2 tomates. Reserva.

En un sartén a fuego medio con 1 cda de aceite, sofríe la cebolla hasta que esté translúcida, unos 3 minutos. Añade los 2 tomates picados y la 1 pizca de sal, cocina por 8 minutos hasta que espese y forme una salsa.
En otro sartén, calienta 1 cda de aceite a fuego medio. Pasa las 4 tortillas de maíz rápidamente por el aceite para que se ablanden y doren ligeramente. Retira y reserva.
En el mismo sartén, cocina los 4 huevos hasta que la clara esté firme y la yema a tu gusto, unos 3-4 minutos.
Sirve dos tortillas en cada plato, coloca encima los 4 huevos, baña con la salsa de tomate y termina con el 1 aguacate cortado en láminas.
tips: Puedes añadir un poco de queso fresco desmoronado si tienes sobrantes.
Si te gusta el picante, puedes añadir un chile fresco picado a la salsa.

recipes.title: Arroz a la mexicana con frijoles y maíz

recipe.title: Arroz a la mexicana con frijoles y maíz
recipe.description: Un plato reconfortante y nutritivo que combina la textura del arroz con la proteína de los frijoles negros y la dulzura del maíz, todo integrado en un sofrito aromático.
instructions: Enjuaga bien los 200 g de arroz bajo agua fría. En una olla, cocina el arroz con el doble de su volumen de agua a fuego suave durante 15 minutos hasta que esté tierno y el agua se haya absorbido.
Mientras, pica la 1/2 cebolla morada y el 1 tomate. Escurre y enjuaga la 1 lata de frijoles negros y los 100 g de maíz.
En un sartén grande, calienta 1 cda de aceite a fuego medio. Sofríe la cebolla y el tomate por 5 minutos hasta que estén suaves.
Incorpora la 1 lata de frijoles negros escurridos y los 100 g de maíz al sartén. Cocina por 5 minutos removiendo suavemente.
Añade los 200 g de arroz ya cocido al sartén, mezcla todo bien durante 2 minutos hasta que esté caliente y sirve inmediatamente.
tips: Este plato mejora su sabor si se deja reposar unos minutos antes de servir.
Puedes agregar un chorrito de lima al final para resaltar los sabores.

recipe.title: Tortillas rellenas con queso y aguacate
recipe.description: Una comida rápida y deliciosa que aprovecha el aguacate maduro. Las tortillas se rellenan con queso fresco y se sirven tibias con una ensalada sencilla de aguacate.
instructions: Corta el 1 aguacate en dados y rocíalo con el jugo de 1 lima para evitar que se oxide. Reserva.
Desmorona los 200 g de queso fresco.
Calienta un sartén a fuego medio. Coloca las 6 tortillas de maíz y caliéntalas por ambos lados, unos 30 segundos por lado.
Rellena cada una de las 6 tortillas de maíz con una porción de los 200 g de queso fresco. Dobla las tortillas por la mitad y deja que el queso se temple unos 2 minutos en el sartén.
Sirve las tortillas calientes acompañadas con los dados de 1 aguacate aliñados.
tips: Puedes doblarlas tipo taco y sellarlas un poco más si prefieres el queso ligeramente derretido.
Si tienes salsa sobrante de otra receta, úsala para acompañar.

recipes.title: Roasted Eggplant with Tahini and Quinoa

recipe.title: Roasted Eggplant with Tahini and Quinoa
recipe.description: A light and nourishing dinner featuring roasted eggplant halves topped with a creamy tahini drizzle and served alongside fluffy, herb-infused quinoa.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Halve the 2 eggplants lengthwise. Score the flesh in a crosshatch pattern. Brush with 1 tbsp of the olive oil.
Roast the 2 eggplants on a baking sheet for 35 minutes until the flesh is very tender and browned.

While roasting, rinse the 150 g of quinoa. Place in a pot with 300 ml of water. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and grains are fluffy.
In a small bowl, whisk the 4 tbsp of tahini with 1 tbsp of lemon juice, 1 clove of minced garlic, and 2 tbsp of cold water until smooth and creamy.
Serve the roasted eggplants topped with the creamy tahini sauce alongside the cooked quinoa.
tips: If you have fresh parsley or cilantro, sprinkle it on top for extra brightness.
If the eggplant is large, it may need 5-10 extra minutes in the oven.

recipes.title: Spinach and Chickpea Stew with Tomato

recipe.title: Spinach and Chickpea Stew with Tomato
recipe.description: A comforting Mediterranean-inspired stew that highlights fresh spinach and hearty chickpeas, slowly simmered with tomatoes to create a light and warming dinner.
instructions: Finely dice the 1 onion and chop the 4 tomatoes into small cubes.
Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Sauté the 1 onion for 5 minutes until soft and translucent.
Add the 4 chopped tomatoes to the pan and cook for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they soften and release their juices into a sauce.
Add the 400 g of chickpeas (canned, drained, and rinsed) to the pan. Simmer for 5 minutes to heat through.
Stir in the 200 g of spinach. Cover the pan and cook for 2 minutes until the spinach is wilted and tender, then serve immediately.
tips: If you have some stale bread, toast it with a little garlic and serve it alongside to soak up the tomato juices.
A pinch of cumin or smoked paprika would pair beautifully with these flavors.

recipes.title: Roasted Tomato and Chickpea Quinoa Bowl

recipe.title: Roasted Tomato and Chickpea Quinoa Bowl
recipe.description: A wholesome and fragrant Mediterranean bowl featuring caramelized roasted tomatoes, nutty quinoa, and creamy tahini, perfect for a balanced evening meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Cut the 4 tomatoes into wedges. Toss them with 1 tbsp of olive oil on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes until soft and slightly caramelized.
Rinse the 150 g of quinoa thoroughly. Place in a pot with 300 ml of water. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the grains are tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together 2 tbsp of tahini, the juice of 1/2 lemon, and 1 tbsp of olive oil until smooth. If too thick, add a teaspoon of warm water.
